assessment.nobel_worthiness: Reframes intracellular organization as liquid-liquid phase separation, a physical-chemical concept (thermodynamics, interfaces, multivalent interactions, non-equilibrium conditions) applied to living cells. P granules and the multivalent-interaction work gave a quantitative framework, and the idea has reshaped cell biology and links to aggregation and amyloid disease. It speaks directly to the physical chemistry of soft matter and self-assembly.
assessment.attribution: Hyman and Brangwynne established the P-granule liquid-droplet picture; Rosen supplied the multivalent-interaction and reconstitution framework. Pappu and Mittag made major sequence-grammar and biophysical contributions, so a three-person limit leaves a real credit tension.
assessment.maturity: More than a decade of reproduction across many systems. The core phenomenon is robust in vitro, though the interpretation of its universality in living cells is still debated, which is reasonable for timing.
uncertainties: Whether condensates in vivo are true equilibrium phase-separated liquids is contested.
Which three of the five credited names best carry the decisive credit is unresolved.
Functional versus incidental condensate claims vary by system.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Ionizable lipid nanoparticles are applied lipid self-assembly: the physical chemistry of lipid phase behaviour, pKa-dependent charge and membrane fusion, and controlled nanoparticle formation, which enabled siRNA drugs and mRNA vaccines. The impact is large and demonstrated in clinical use, and the underlying lipid and membrane science is close to my own field.
assessment.attribution: The Vancouver group (Cullis, Hope, Madden) developed the formulation and process principles; Anderson, Langer and MacLachlan contributed ionizable lipid design and translation. I propose the formulation-physics core, but the credit split against the lipid-design contributors is unclear.
assessment.maturity: Strongly confirmed by approved products and independent adoption. Timing is mature, though the 2023 mRNA prize may complicate how the committee frames a separate delivery prize.
uncertainties: Overlap with the 2023 Nobel recognition of mRNA vaccine work may weigh against a separate prize.
Division of credit between formulation scientists and ionizable-lipid chemists is disputed.
My knowledge of exact priority details is from memory and not verified.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Targeted protein degradation opens a new modality: induced proximity to E3 ligases for catalytic removal of proteins. PROTACs and molecular glues work as chemistry-driven drug discovery, with mechanistic insight into cereblon and VHL ligands, and growing clinical programmes.
assessment.attribution: Crews and Deshaies conceived and built early PROTACs; Ciulli designed VHL ligands and structurally defined ternary complexes. Handa, Ito and others uncovered the thalidomide-cereblon mechanism, so the molecular-glue half may need separate treatment.
assessment.maturity: Many independent groups and many clinical trials, but no approved PROTAC drug yet to my knowledge, so clinical vindication is still pending.
uncertainties: The compound discovery has PROTAC and molecular-glue parts with different contributors.
Clinical success is not yet established.
Credit among the eight listed names is complex.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Genetic code expansion lets proteins carry designed noncanonical amino acids in living cells via orthogonal tRNA-synthetase pairs. It is original, conceptually clean, and widely used for probes, photocrosslinking and protein engineering.
assessment.attribution: Schultz and coworkers made the first orthogonal pairs for cells; Wang was the key early experimentalist; Chin extended to multiple codons and ribosome engineering. Mehl and Yokoyama also contributed, so a three-name set omits meaningful work.
assessment.maturity: Two decades of confirmation and wide adoption; the field is stable.
uncertainties: Priority among Schultz, Wang and Chin and others is somewhat entangled.
Therapeutic and industrial payoff is still modest relative to the methods impact.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Nanopore sensing of single molecules built on ion-channel biophysics and led to portable DNA and RNA sequencing; a physical-chemical idea with real-world impact.
assessment.attribution: Branton and Deamer, with Church, proposed and demonstrated strand translocation; Kasianowicz showed polynucleotide detection; Bayley engineered protein pores; Akeson did the key sequencing-relevant control. Unresolved who should be central.
assessment.maturity: Commercially mature and independently reproduced, though accuracy and the original concept's attribution have been discussed.
uncertainties: Credit is spread across at least five people, and the original idea involves Church, who is not listed.
Methods impact is stronger than a single fundamental discovery.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Native mass spectrometry preserves non-covalent assemblies in the gas phase, giving stoichiometry, lipid and ligand binding in membrane protein complexes. It is chemically significant and connects to membrane protein-lipid interactions.
assessment.attribution: Chait and Robinson, with Heck, drove the intact-complex and membrane-protein methods; Loo and Gross contributed earlier ionization and solution-phase concepts.
assessment.maturity: Mature and widely used, but partly overlaps with the 2002 MS recognition and has a more incremental history.
uncertainties: Whether gas-phase structure reliably reflects solution structure is debated.
Overlap with previous mass spectrometry prizes.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Energy landscape and funnel theory transformed the understanding of protein folding and Levinthal's paradox through statistical physics, and has links to self-assembly and aggregation.
assessment.attribution: Wolynes, Onuchic and Dill are central theorists; Bryngelson and Fersht have key early or experimental contributions. The theory-versus-experiment credit is unresolved.
assessment.maturity: Concepts are widely accepted and tested, but the recent AlphaFold recognition changes the framing of folding work.
uncertainties: The 2024 prize on protein structure prediction may reduce appetite for another protein folding prize.
Theory has been less decisive in predicting new phenomena.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Halide perovskite solar cells reached high efficiency very quickly, a major materials-chemistry advance in energy conversion.
assessment.attribution: Miyasaka made the first perovskite-sensitized cell; Park and Snaith made the solid-state efficiency steps. Grätzel, Seok, Kanatzidis also contributed, so credit is crowded.
assessment.maturity: Efficiencies are confirmed, but long-term stability and commercialization remain open, so recognition may be premature.
